plate-name.purpose: The page name in a title block. The only large type in the system.

figure.purpose: A count in a specification strip. Tabular, always.

label.purpose: Field labels, column heads, legends. Archivo Narrow, caps, tracked 0.14em.

section.purpose: A ruled section title inside a plate.

reference.purpose: Order references, item codes, emails. Tracked narrow caps standing in for a monospace the system refuses.

motion.name: ease-draw
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out. The only easing in the system.

motion.name: measure-draw
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: a measure's fill and annotation sweep from the left on load and on every data change. Parked at its final value under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Ink and rule-weight changes on hover, focus and active. Nothing else transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The action colour, Thomax light blue. Used only where something can actually be done; disabled loses the colour entirely.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; background:#049DCE; color:#10141C; border:1px solid #10141C; border-radius:0; padding:12px 24px; font-family:'Archivo Narrow',Archivo,Arial,sans-serif; font-size:.75rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.13em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background:#2FB4E2; } .ds-btn:disabled { background:#F4F7FC; color:#5C657A; border-color:#C9D2E2; cursor:not-allowed; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #049DCE; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A secondary action. Ink outline that inverts on hover; never takes the action colour.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background:transparent; color:#10141C; border:1px solid #10141C; border-radius:0; padding:12px 24px; font-family:'Archivo Narrow',Archivo,Arial,sans-serif; font-size:.75rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.13em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),color 120ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:#10141C; color:#FFFFFF; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Square field on plate stock. Focus takes an ink border plus a light-blue outline.
components.css: .ds-input { background:#FFFFFF; color:#10141C; border:1px solid #5C657A; border-radius:0; padding:8px 12px; font-family:Archivo,Arial,sans-serif; font-size:.8125rem; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#5C657A; font-family:'Archivo Narrow',Archivo,Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.04em; } .ds-input:hover { border-color:#10141C; } .ds-input:focus { border-color:#10141C; outline:2px solid #049DCE; outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Navigation Rail
components.description: A full-height deep-blue rail down the left. The active cell inverts to plate white, so the rail shows which sheet is open. No accent stripe.
components.css: .ds-rail { display:flex; flex-direction:column; width:240px; background:#012DAE; } .ds-navcell { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:16px 24px; border-bottom:1px solid #2A51C4; color:#9FB4EC; font-family:'Archivo Narrow',Archivo,Arial,sans-serif; font-size:.75rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.13em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-navcell:hover { color:#F2F6FF; background:#011C6E; } .ds-navcell--active { color:#10141C; background:#FFFFFF; }

components.name: Plate
components.description: The only container in the system. A 2px ink edge on stock, with a ruled head and any number of ruled sections. Never nested, never shadowed, never rounded.
components.css: .ds-plate { background:#FFFFFF; border:2px solid #10141C; } .ds-plate-head { border-bottom:2px solid #10141C; padding:24px 24px 0; } .ds-plate-name { margin:0; font-family:Archivo,Arial,sans-serif; font-size:1.75rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.02em; line-height:1.05; } .ds-fields { display:flex; margin:16px 0 0; border-top:1px solid #C9D2E2; } .ds-fields > div { padding:12px 24px 12px 0; margin-right:24px; border-right:1px solid #C9D2E2; } .ds-fields > div:last-child { border-right:0; margin-right:0; padding-right:0; } .ds-fields dt { margin:0 0 2px; font-family:'Archivo Narrow',Archivo,Arial,sans-serif; font-size:.6875rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#454D5C; } .ds-fields dd { margin:0; font-size:.875rem; font-weight:600; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-plate-body { padding:24px; }

components.name: Measure
components.description: The signature component. A measured value drawn as a drafting dimension: centre rule, witness ticks, fill band, and the figure annotated where the measurement ends. The deficit is named on its own line.
components.html:
Queue packed against orders raised2 / 3
67%

Waiting — 1 order
components.css: .ds-measure { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px; font-family:Archivo,Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-measure-head { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:baseline; } .ds-measure-label,.ds-measure-deficit { font-family:'Archivo Narrow',Archivo,Arial,sans-serif; font-size:.6875rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#454D5C; } .ds-measure-ratio { font-family:'Archivo Narrow',Archivo,Arial,sans-serif; font-size:.8125rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.06em; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-measure-track { position:relative; height:30px; } .ds-measure-track::before { content:''; position:absolute; left:0; right:0; top:50%; height:1px; background:#10141C; } .ds-tick { position:absolute; top:0; bottom:0; width:1px; background:#10141C; } .ds-tick--a { left:0; } .ds-tick--b { right:0; } .ds-measure-fill { position:absolute; left:0; top:5px; bottom:5px; background:#012DAE; transform-origin:left center; animation:ds-draw 520ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both; } .ds-measure-value { position:absolute; top:50%; transform:translate(-100%,-50%); padding-right:12px; color:#F2F6FF; font-size:1.125rem; font-weight:700; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-measure-unit { font-family:'Archivo Narrow',Archivo,Arial,sans-serif; font-size:.6875rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.1em; margin-left:2px; color:#9FB4EC; } .ds-measure-deficit { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin:0; padding-top:8px; border-top:1px solid #C9D2E2; color:#B3261E; } .ds-measure-deficit::before { content:''; width:18px; border-top:2px solid currentColor; } @keyframes ds-draw { from { transform:scaleX(0); } }

components.name: Status Mark
components.description: Status as a mark in a fixed cell, never a pill. Hollow for draft, hatched for packing, filled for packed and failed.
components.html: packed draft packing failed
components.css: .ds-state { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-family:'Archivo Narrow',Archivo,Arial,sans-serif; font-size:.6875rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-state::before { content:''; width:10px; height:10px; border:1px solid currentColor; background:currentColor; } .ds-state--draft { color:#5C657A; } .ds-state--draft::before { background:transparent; } .ds-state--packing { color:#03769E; } .ds-state--packing::before { background:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,currentColor 0 2px,transparent 2px 4px); } .ds-state--packed { color:#012DAE; } .ds-state--failed { color:#B3261E; }

narrative.overview:
Bionic Portal is drawn as an industrial parts-standard sheet. Every carton, item and order is a specified part with a number, a dimension table and a line drawing, and the page is the sheet those things are printed on. It refuses what this category always ships: white rounded cards on tinted grey, one blue accent, a stat tile per metric, status as a coloured pill.

The content is numbers in millimetres, read by two people handing work between them and demonstrated on a projector in a bright room. So the system is light, flat and ruled. Nothing has a radius, a shadow or a gradient; separation is done entirely with rule weight and stock tint, which puts the whole page's weight on alignment.

The palette is Thomax's own, sampled from their logo and pinned: deep blue #012DAE, light blue #049DCE, white. Deep blue is a field that owns whole regions — the full-height navigation rail down the left, the load plan, the sign-in plate. Light blue is the action colour and appears only where something can be done, so scanning a page for light blue is the same as scanning it for what you can press. The sheet you have open is pulled out of the rail: the active cell inverts to plate white.
keyCharacteristics: Thomax's own two blues on white, sampled from their logo and pinned
A full-height deep-blue navigation rail; the open sheet inverts out of it
Light blue strictly as the action colour; disabled loses it entirely
Zero radius, zero shadow, zero gradient — rule weight and stock tint are the only dividers
Archivo and Archivo Narrow only; no monospace, tabular figures everywhere
Every measured value drawn as a drafting dimension with witness ticks
Boxes drawn as 30-degree axonometric wireframes with a labelled dimension line per axis

rules.name: The light-blue rule
rules.body: Light blue marks what can be done and nothing else. A disabled control drops to stock-wash on rule with ink-3 text. If an element is light blue and cannot be clicked, it is a bug.

rules.name: Status never borrows the action colour
rules.body: Status lives in its own desaturated ink family and is carried by a mark in a fixed cell, not by a tint on a pill.

rules.name: Colour owns regions, not edges
rules.body: A field colour fills a whole topbar or a whole plate. There are no coloured side stripes and no tinted card borders.

rules.name: Labels are narrow, tracked and capital
rules.body: Field labels, column heads, references and status words are Archivo Narrow uppercase. Content is not. A label set in sentence case stops reading as a field name.

rules.name: A page name carries no label above it
rules.body: The title block states the name first, then its field/value pairs underneath. There are no eyebrows in this system.

rules.name: Depth is rule weight
rules.body: 2px ink closes a plate and its head; 1px ink divides ruled sections; 1px rule divides rows and cells. No shadow, no blur, no translucency.

rules.name: Name the deficit
rules.body: A measured value states what did not fit on its own line, with a leader rule. Nothing short is allowed to hide inside a percentage.

rules.name: The open sheet leaves the rail
rules.body: The active navigation cell inverts to plate white with ink text. No accent stripe down its edge — a coloured border on one side of a list item is the side-tab tell and belongs to no system.

dos: Do give every page a plate and a title block carrying real data
Do set every field label, column head and reference in Archivo Narrow caps, tracked, and every figure in tabular numerals
Do reserve light blue for things that can be done, and take it away when they cannot
Do draw a measured value as a dimension, and name its deficit on its own line
Do let a field colour own a whole region when a region deserves the weight
Do theme the browser's own surfaces: selection, caret, scrollbars, focus rings
donts: Don't add a radius, a shadow, a gradient or a translucent layer
Don't put a label above a heading
Don't use a status colour where an action colour belongs, or the reverse
Don't use monospace to signal 'technical'; use tabular figures
Don't put a Unicode glyph where an icon belongs
Don't let a register squeeze a column away; let it scroll
Don't mark an active nav item with a coloured edge stripe; invert it instead
